# The Black Circle

> The Black Circle is a multi-jurisdictional private wealth management group
> regulated in the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, and ADGM,
> serving professional and institutional clients with wealth planning,
> investment management, secondary market deals, and tailored solutions.

Key facts:
- BVI FSC regulated investment manager (Approved Managers Regs)
- Multi-jurisdictional: BVI · Cayman · ADGM
- Entities: TBCWM International Limited (BVI #2202526), The Black Circle Investment SPC (Cayman #432397), The Black Circle SPV Limited (ADGM)
- Professional & institutional clients only
- Languages: English, Arabic, 繁體中文

## Solutions

- [Wealth Planning](https://theblackcircle.com/solutions/wealth-planning/): Structuring and succession arrangements for continuity and control across generations
- [Investment Management](https://theblackcircle.com/solutions/investment/): Discretionary management of traditional and alternative portfolios
- [Secondary Market Deals](https://theblackcircle.com/request-access/): Curated access to secondary market opportunities across US and global markets
- [Tailored Solutions](https://theblackcircle.com/solutions/tailored-solutions/): Bespoke solutions for private banks and family offices
- [Gold Solutions](https://theblackcircle.com/solutions/gold/): Physical gold — allocated positions to gold-backed financing
- [Bitcoin Solutions](https://theblackcircle.com/solutions/bitcoin-and-crypto-backed-lending/): Bitcoin-backed financing and yield
